name: Dracula
hook: The 1897 vampire novel that invented the modern Count — by a writer who never saw Romania.

facts.label: Bram Stoker
facts.statement: Bram Stoker was a Dublin-born drama critic who managed an actor's tour of America but never visited Romania; Dracula appeared in 1897.

facts.label: Jonathan Harker
facts.statement: Jonathan Harker is the young solicitor whose journal opens the novel as he travels to the Count's castle in the Carpathians.

facts.label: Vlad the Impaler
facts.statement: Vlad the Impaler, a 15th-century prince of Wallachia in present-day Romania, is the historical Dracula; Bran Castle is linked to the novel.

facts.label: Van Helsing
facts.statement: Van Helsing is the Dutch physician and vampire expert who leads the group that destroys Dracula.

facts.label: Nosferatu
facts.statement: The 1922 German silent film was an unlicensed adaptation, and its producer was accused of ripping off Stoker's novel.

facts.label: Bela Lugosi
facts.statement: Hungarian-born Bela Lugosi starred in the 1931 film and was offered Frankenstein's monster before Boris Karloff.

facts.label: The Lair of the White Worm
facts.statement: The Lair of the White Worm is another Stoker horror novel, named for a colorful snakelike creature.
associations: The Lair of the White Worm
